verdict.rationale: First-party docs say founders can model their next round and explore hypothetical future rounds in a built-in scenario-modeling feature, which is included even in the entry plan. Scenarios can be exported for review, and term sheets and financing documents can be generated. The docs do not detail the specific mechanics of the story, and export is framed as reviewing 'with your team', not sharing directly with counsel or investors. Missing for 10: explicit dilution and pro-forma ownership tables, option pool top-up modeling, SAFE conversion modeling, a documented way to share scenarios with external counsel/investors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors
